messages:
sarah.sales: FYI CodaHealth (CISO + CFO) escalated: encryption-at-rest key ownership + 99.9% throughput SLA needed for POC. They're pausing demo until clarified. Need unblock from Security & Infra. cc @oliver_vp_sales

oliver_vp_sales: Thanks Sarah. Can SE/Infra/Security weigh in? This is a potential multi-year deal, want fast unblock.

mike_se: I can own checklist. Quick Q: do they require BYO-KMS or just customer-managed keys in our KMS? I thought earlier discussion said CMEK.

anya_security: They wrote 'customer key control' — need to confirm BYO-HSM vs CMEK. @julia_legal can we allow BYO-HSM for Hosted? Hosted currently supports CMEK via cloud KMS; HSM requires Private.

julia_legal: Legal is OK to permit BYO-KMS with a contract addendum + DPA. BYO-HSM for hosted is high risk; we'll need additional attestation and indemnity. Send me their legal contact.

tom_infra: From infra: we can enable CMEK for a Dedicated tenant in ~48-72h. BYO-HSM requires Private (2-3w). Throughput SLA: we can promise 99.9% for committed Dedicated pool; need sizing info (QPS, tokens/s, seq len).

sarah.sales: They asked for ~1k concurrent sessions, ~8k tokens/s sustained, mostly generation, seq length up to 1024. Budget is tight.

mike_se: For 8k tokens/s sustained, sizing estimate: Dedicated pool ~8x A100-equivalent. I'll put together a cost sketch. Also propose enabling prefix caching + quantized model to hit cost targets.

anya_security: For the POC we can do CMEK (customer KMS) in Hosted Dedicated and provide a KMS rotation policy doc and key access matrix. For HSM we need Private. Drafting attestation now.

julia_legal: I'll prepare the contract addendum and push an expedited review. We also need SSO + DPA signed before live tests. Share customer's in-house counsel.

oliver_vp_sales: Please set an exec sync with their CISO + CFO tomorrow EOD; I'll join. Goal: confirm key control approach and SLA tradeoffs.

sarah.sales: Booked 30m with CodaHealth CISO + CFO for tomorrow 2pm PT. Invite sent. @mike_se @anya_security @tom_infra pls join.

deploy-bot: Reminder: RFC 4823 deployment window reserved (48-72h) pending infra tasks. Ticket #INF-9876

tom_infra: Opening INF-9876 with required config: enable CMEK on dedicated tenant, sizing for 8k tokens/s, monitoring SLOs. Assign to infra-oncall.

mike_se: I'll attach sizing + pricing estimate to INF-9876 by EOD today (includes cost for 8x A100-equivalent baseline + cache/quantization options).

anya_security: :thumbsup: posting KMS attestation draft to the ticket in 30m.

julia_legal: If they insist on BYO-HSM, we escalate to Product for a Private deployment quote. Otherwise we keep POC in Dedicated to shorten timeline.

oliver_vp_sales: Agreed — prioritize Dedicated path to accelerate. Sarah, confirm the exec sync attendees and prepare a 1-slide summary: key control options + SLA/size/cost delta.

sarah.sales: Will share 1-pager + slide before the sync. Thanks everyone — goal is to have decision point ready during exec call.
